verses.en: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.sm: Tavita i ona puapuaga uma lava;

verses.en: How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;
verses.sm: ole na tauto i le ALII, na tuuautapu i lē Malosi o Iakopo;

verses.en: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.sm: sa faapea, E moni, ou te le alu i le fale ie o loʻu fale, pe alu ae i loʻu moega, o le mea e toe ai;

verses.en: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,
verses.sm: oute le mafai ona moe oʻu mata, pe rnatàmoe oʻu laumata,

verses.en: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
verses.sm: seia on maua se mea e afio ai le ALII, o le afioaga mo lē Malosi o Iakopo.

verses.en: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
verses.sm: Faauta, na tatou faalogo i ai i Efarata; na tatou maua i fanua o i le vao.

verses.en: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.sm: Tatou te o lava i ona afioaga; tatou te ifo atu i luma o le mea e tu ai ona aao.

verses.en: Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
verses.sm: Io II 12 13 14 15 16 17 SALAMO 132, Le ALI e, ia E tulai atu i lou malologa,

verses.en: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
verses.sm: o oe ma le atolaau o lou malosi. la oofu au ositaulaga i le amiotonu,

verses.en: For thy servant David's sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
verses.sm: ma ia alaga fiafia ou tagata amio Atua. Aua le “alo ou fofoga i le ua e faauuina,

verses.en: The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.
verses.sm: ona o lau auauna o Tavita. Na tauto le ALII ia Tavita i le faamaoni, e le ‘alo ese ai o ia, Ou te faanofoina i lou nofoalii so le fanau a lou tino.

verses.en: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
verses.sm: Afai e tausi au fanau i laʻu feagaiga ma aʻu tulafono ou te aʻoaʻoina ai i latou, ona nonofo lea o la latou fanau i lou nofoālii e faavavau lava.

verses.en: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.
verses.sm: Auā ua filifilia Siona e le ALII; ua finagalo lava i ai e fai mona afioaga.

verses.en: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.sm: O loʻu malologa lenei e faavavau; o le mea nei ou te nofo ai, auā ua ou manao ai.

verses.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.sm: Ou te matuā faamanuia ana mea e ‘ai; ou te faamaoona ona tagata matitiva i le areto.

verses.en: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.sm: Ou te faaofuina ana ositaulaga i le olataga; e alalaga foi ma le olioli ona tagata amio Atua.

verses.en: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.
verses.sm: Ou te faatupuina ai le nifo mo Tavita; ua ou saunia le lamepa mo le ua ou faauuina.

verses.en: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.sm: Ou te faaofuina o e ita ia te ia i le ma; a e pupula mai lona palealii i luga ia te ia.
